questions.prompt: A partner criticizes the familiar arrangement. Acknowledge the concern, give a suitable response and clarify the action you agree to take.
questions.context:
A partner criticizes you for not coming at the agreed time and asks you to come tomorrow. You acknowledge the missed meeting and apologize. You agree to tomorrow, but the time tomorrow is not yet agreed. Respond to the criticism and clarify that remaining detail; no other fault has been alleged.
Familiar meanings available: to answer; to respond; to apologize; to criticize; criticism; sorry; to agree; to consent.
questions.label: Take your speaking turn

rubric.text: I made the agreed action clear without accepting an unstated claim.

questions.prompt: Write a short handover about the familiar exchange: what was requested, what was agreed and what remains to do.
questions.context:
A partner asked you to come today. You explained that you could not and apologized. You both agreed to tomorrow instead. The time tomorrow still needs to be chosen; no visit has occurred. Write a handover preserving request, agreement and remaining action.
Familiar meanings available: to answer; to respond; to apologize; suggest; suggestion; because; owing to; to agree; to consent.
questions.label: Write your own message

rubric.text: I kept the request, agreement and completed action distinct.
The reader can identify who is responsible for the remaining action.
